observation: The owner approved a focused correction procedure after reviewing avoidable diagnostic loops, broad reruns and intermediate publication.
cause: Existing evidence and acceptance rules were not consistently applied as early decision gates.
proposed_rule: Define the bounded change, preview the affected shape early, use proportional checks, reduce repeated failures to a minimal reproduction, and publish only the reviewed candidate from isolated staging. Use targeted discovery and managed-file staging.
evidence: Owner-approved Focused working-skill update: efficient, evidence-led corrections, 2026-10-17
limits: Instruction-only review; no fresh drawing, runtime, source-accuracy, phone or customer-acceptance claim. Existing required audits remain in force. Project-specific facts stay in project evidence.
